Author: n0way02
Name: FateFrenzy
Punchline: FATEs, farmed for you with frenzy!
Description: Farms FATEs for you: tick the zones, and the plugin teleports in, finds active FATEs, and runs them in a loop, with Lifestream support for instance, world, and local crystal navigation.

Author: n0way02
Name: Digitas Automatizados
Punchline: Smart auto-typer for the Keybound Brawler minigame.
Description: Smart, high-performance auto-typer and Auto-Loop farmer for the Gold Saucer Keybound Brawler minigame (FFXIV x FFVII).

Author: n0way02
Name: SubFrenzy
Punchline: Track your Submarine Gil & Salvaged loot by day, month, year, and character.
Description: Automatic Submarine Gil & Salvaged Accessories tracker for FFXIV. Works seamlessly with AutoRetainer (including Multi-Mode across alts) to log all 8 Salvaged vendor items by exact date, character, day, month, and year with visual bar charts and bilingual EN/PT-BR UI.

Author: n0way02
Name: FriendList Frenzy
Punchline: Enhanced Friend List with native in-game Friend Groups, bulk group sync & safe Bulk Removal.
Description: Modern FFXIV Friend List manager with native in-game Friend Group recognition & bulk sync (add, change, or remove friends from FFXIV Friend Groups in bulk), instant search, nicknames, notes, Last Seen tracking, protected favorites, and safe Bulk Friend Removal. Bilingual EN / PT-BR UI.

Author: n0way02
Name: PetFrenzy
Punchline: Animated Eorzea Tamagotchi pet with Live Multiplayer, Job weapons, Lv.100 progression & Wardrobe!
Description: Animated Eorzea Tamagotchi companion for FFXIV with Live Multiplayer! Hatch a Carbuncle, Fat Cat, Moogle, or Namazu, see nearby & party (including Cross-World!) players' pets live, level up to Lv.100 across ALL FFXIV content (including BLU & BST), equip all 43 Job weapons & tools, and customize Hats, Outfits, Wings, Weapon Auras, and RGB Colors.
